title: AI TRAFFIC SIGNAL SYSTEM 429 JUNCTIONS
summary: Civic and traffic authorities are advancing plans to deploy an AI-driven adaptive traffic signal system across 429 major junctions in Hyderabad under the Core Urban Region Economy (CURE) initiative to ease peak-hour congestion and improve junction flow. Unlike fixed-timer signals, adaptive AI signals use real-time traffic cameras and sensors to measure vehicle queues on each arm of a junction and dynamically adjust green-light durations—reducing unnecessary waiting on empty stretches and creating green corridors for emergency vehicles.
